method: MERAKit.jl (Hauru 2007.03638) ternary MERA, Riemannian LBFGS, direct-init at bond dim 6, block_size=2, dense ComplexSpace. Julia 1.8.5, SINGLE-THREAD BLAS (deterministic). Critical Ising (J XX + h Z). One-site scaling superoperator A^(1) (center isometry channel) diagonalized for scaling operators phi_alpha and dims Delta=-log_3(lambda). One-site fixed-point density matrix rho1 (descend channel), rho3 = w rho1 w' (3 children of one isometry), rho2 = Tr_3 rho3. Gram-Schmidt orthonormalize {I,sigma,eps} under rho2 (paper Eq. 10). OPE C_abc = 3^Omega tr[(phi_a ox phi_b ox phi_c) rho3], Omega = Da+Db-Dc (Pfeifer-Evenbly-Vidal Eq. 13, binary 2^Omega -> ternary 3^Omega). 6 deterministic seeds, 900 iters.
model: critical Ising (c=1/2) -- VALIDATION CASE for the OPE pipeline (exact CFT C_sigma_sigma_eps = 0.5)
purpose: Run B: extract the OPE structure constant C_{sigma sigma eps} from MERA and validate against the known Ising value 0.5 BEFORE trusting any tricritical C_TTT. Pre-registered gate: |C_sse - 0.5| must be small at the reachable chi.
env: research/tools/merakit-setup/RUN-MERAKIT.md (Julia 1.8, clean HOME, --project=.); export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 for determinism

what_works.merakit_runs: ternary MERA optimizes; E(chi=6) ~ -1.273232 vs exact -4/pi=-1.273240 (err ~7e-6 on best basin)
what_works.determinism: single-thread BLAS makes minimize_expectation reproducible (3 trials seed1 identical E=-1.2732186548); multi-thread BLAS lands DIFFERENT basins per run -- this was the cause of earlier non-reproducibility
what_works.scaling_dimensions: width-2 scalingdimensions reproduces the Ising CFT tower on clean basins: best seed {0, 0.121 (sigma, CFT 0.125), 0.981 (eps, CFT 1.0), 1.118, 1.135, 1.857, 1.892, 1.969}; Delta_T~2.0 present
what_works.two_point_normalization: Gram-Schmidt under rho2 gives <sigma|eps>=0 to 1e-15, <ss>=<ee>=1 (paper Eq. 10 satisfied cleanly)

best_spectrum_seed.selection: width-2 Delta_sigma nearest CFT 1/8 (cleanest fixed point)

verdict: VALIDATION GATE NOT PASSED. The extracted C_{sigma sigma eps} does NOT reproduce 0.5 and is UNSTABLE across basins: across 6 deterministic chi=6 seeds |C_sse| ranged 0.08..17.2 (best-spectrum seed 5 gave 0.082; a poor-spectrum seed accidentally gave 0.477). The parity-forbidden |C_sss| (must vanish by Z2) ranged 0.09..92 and ANTI-correlated with dimension cleanliness, proving the rho^(3) 3-point object is geometrically WRONG, not merely under-converged. The dimensions and 2-point normalization ARE correct (Delta_sigma->0.121, Delta_eps->0.981, <sigma|eps>=0), so the failure is isolated to the 3-point density matrix construction.
root_cause: rho^(3) = w rho1 w' (three children of ONE ternary isometry) is NOT a translation-invariant 3-contiguous-site CFT density matrix: within a ternary block sites 1,2,3 are inequivalent (the center site does not touch a disentangler, the edges do). A correct width-3 scale-invariant marginal needs the full causal cone INCLUDING the inter-block disentanglers, or the genuine PEV algorithm of coarse-graining each operator individually until adjacent (their Fig 2iii). Neither is implemented here.
chi_is_not_the_blocker: Dimensions are already clean at chi=6 (Delta_sigma=0.121 vs CFT 0.125). Pushing chi will NOT fix C_sse; the rho^(3) CONSTRUCTION must be corrected first. Once correct, chi=10-12 (RunPod A100/H100) would tighten sigma to 1/8 and the structure constant in turn.
next_step: Implement the correct width-3 causal-cone density matrix (with disentanglers) in qw_ope_constants.jl, re-validate that C_sse->0.5 stably across basins AND C_sss->0, THEN and only then extract tricritical C_TTT.
notes: Honest negative result per the killer-issue discipline: a structure constant is INVALID unless the validation case (Ising 0.5) is reproduced first. It is not. Real numbers reported, not fudged. Determinism fix (single-thread BLAS) and clean dimension/2-point extraction are reusable wins carried forward.
